CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: selfhost/main.prn: real fifth self-hosting domain, a faithful port of src/main.c's cmd_build. build-file does a real disk-to-disk compile (read .prn file -> lexer -> parser -> region -> emit -> write .c file), completing the full pipeline as a real, callable, end-to-end build function. Found and fixed 2 real bugs: a region.prn/emit.prn private-helper-name collision (never exercised before both were compiled together), and a match-bound Ok defstruct payload needing deref when passed by value. 7 new assertions, CI green on all 4 jobs. PARENA commit 2249627, Apple #16364. session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
